newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt stock trade resumes after glitch.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt stock trade resumes after glitch.

text.p: Trading on the Frankfurt stock exchange was free to start again from 0925 GMT on Friday after a technical failure had made dealing impossible for an hour, the bourse said.
A bourse spokesman also said that floor dealings could begin as normal at 0930 GMT.
The technical failure, for which there was no immediate explanation, started at around 0815 GMT during IBIS electronic pre-bourse dealings.
The problem was rectified at around 0915 GMT but there was an initial delay in full resumption of trading for a brief transition period.
